decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed gazebo/summer house would be an intrusive element in the area, would be out of character with existing and surrounding development and would have a negative effect on the visual amenity of the locality. The proposal would therefore detract from the character and appearance of the Bradford Park Conservation Area. The proposal is considered to be contrary to Policies ENV 1.1, ENV 1.2 and H 3.4 of Council's Unitary Development Plan. 

2.	The proposed gazebo/summer house poses detrimental impacts for the amenity of adjoining properties in terms of its appearance, size, design and overlooking. The impact of the appearance of the development and the loss of privacy to adjoining properties is unacceptable and is contrary to Policy ENV 1.1 of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a shed in rear garden of existing dwellinghouse.
